'''Meene''' is an independent system in the Core Systems, reached by Commanders pursuing '''[[Ram Tah]]''''s limpet-controller and Guardian-technology Engineering after a referral from [[Lei Cheung]]. It hosts '''[[Phoenix Base]]''', Ram Tah's workshop and the centre of his Guardian research.<ref name="inara-meene">[https://inara.cz/elite/starsystem/19583/ Meene — Star System], Inara.</ref>

== Overview ==

* '''Star:''' Class F (scoopable)
* '''Allegiance:''' Independent
* '''Government:''' Confederacy
* '''Security:''' Medium
* '''Economy:''' Industrial / Extraction<ref name="inara-meene" />

Meene has also seen a history of Background Simulation conflict between local minor factions; check current system state before relying on any particular faction being in control when you arrive.<ref name="inara-meene" />

== Engineer Facility ==

'''[[Phoenix Base]]''' is a surface Engineer base in Meene, operated by '''[[Ram Tah]]'''.<ref name="inara-phoenix-base">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/55499/ Phoenix Base in Meene — Station], Inara.</ref>

No system permit is required to enter Meene. See [[Ram Tah]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements for his workshop.
